strongest_angle: The prosecution at Southwark Crown Court has framed Russell Brand as a calculated predator, alleging a decade-long pattern of abuse against six women who came forward independently.

key_facts.fact: Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones KC opened the case at Southwark Crown Court by describing Russell Brand as a ruthless and calculated sexual predator.
The prosecution alleges that Russell Brand assaulted six women over the course of a decade.
Riel Karmy-Jones KC stated that the six women involved in the case did not know each other and came forward independently to report the offenses.
Russell Brand is 51 years old and is currently facing seven sexual offense charges at his trial in London.

quotes.text: The women did not know each other, have never met each other and came forward independently of each other.
quotes.speaker: Riel Karmy-Jones KC
